problem: 尺码偏差 / 版型不合适
example_review: I love tracy reese dresses, but this one is not for the very petite. i am just under 5 feet tall and usually wear a 0p in this brand. this dress was very pretty out of the package but its a lot of dress. the skirt is long and very full so it overwhelmed my small frame. not a stranger to alterations, shortening and narrowing the skirt would take away from the embellishment of the garment. i love the color and the idea of the style but it just did not work on me. i returned this dress.
operation_strategy: 优化尺码表，增加模特身高体重、试穿报告和尺码推荐说明，降低用户选择成本。
